run_save_world: run a pybullet script that connects via shared memory and saves the current world state to a timestamped Python file
connect_pybullet_shared_memory: connect to the pybullet physics simulator using shared memory mode for inter-process communication
set_additional_search_path: set an additional search path for pybullet data assets using pybullet_data getDataPath
save_world_to_file: save the current pybullet simulation world state to a timestamped Python script file
disconnect_pybullet: disconnect from the pybullet physics simulator after saving the world state
